info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Information Engineering and Computer Science

description.describe_ch: 本課程藉由邀請國內外資訊工程相關領域與資訊工程倫理的學者專家蒞臨演講，讓學生了解資工領域的現況與趨勢，並熟悉學術倫理和智慧財產權相關的法規、知識與個案實例。希望藉由學術演講的聆聽與討論，啟發學生關注前瞻性與國際性資訊科技的發展與脈動，並培養學生聽講、討論、發問與撰寫書面心得報告的能力。
description.describe_eh: By inviting scholars and experts from various areas of information engineering and computer science to delivery their domain knowledge to students , their course allows students to understand the current status and future friends towards existing and newly established research areas , and families students with academic ethics and intellectual property rights issues and legislation . also , through listening and discussion in the seminars , it will inspires students' attention to the visionary and global developments in information technologies.

targets.describe_en: understand current status and future trends of information engineering related research areas.

targets.describe_ch: 理解學術倫理和智慧財產權相關的法規、知識，並舉出適當的個案實例。
targets.describe_en: understand academic ethics and intellectual property related issues and legislation，and then propose suitable examples
